Explore the aircraft above you, follow a flight across the map, or inspect traffic around an airport. SkyTrace combines live positions, recorded airport movements, route details and aircraft profiles in one responsive interface.
The same workflows are available on desktop and phone. Data coverage and enrichment depend on the providers; unknown routes and delayed feeds are labelled in the interface.
features: Explore live traffic. Pan and zoom the map, filter aircraft by altitude or identity, switch units and map theme, and spot emergency squawks. Aircraft with enough position data glide between feed updates. Turn on Display…

Inspect a flight. Aircraft reveal callsigns at zoom 8, operating-airline logos at zoom 10, and altitude/speed at zoom 12. Screen-space collision detection keeps labels sparse; the selected aircraft keeps its detail…
Search in one place. Find a visible aircraft by callsign, ticket flight number (AF1234 finds AFR1234), registration, type or airline, or find an airport by name, city, IATA or ICAO code.

Find airports on the map. Blue markers cover all geolocated airports in the bundled catalogue. Nearby markers form numbered groups; click to zoom in, then open arrivals and departures. Use Display → Favourite airports…
